THE PERSON BEHIND THE PROJECTS

Hi, I’m Uri.

CTO · Unity & backend developer

I build games and the systems that power them. My experience spans hands-on technical leadership, Unity clients, backend services, and authoritative multiplayer, through to analytics and mobile store releases.

As CTO at Lootheads, I set technical direction, selected systems and APIs, and helped the team prioritize and deliver features. I enjoy working across disciplines, learning independently, and turning ideas into working games.
